scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WORKER,WEB -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start:test: concurrently -n API,WORKER -c magenta,yellow "npm run start -w backend" "npm run worker:start -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
